items.title: Ray Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998
items.q: George Barns I think won it. He was older than me. I was 15 and I think he was about 18 or 19. But you were supposed to be amateur, you couldn’t belong to the union you know. And so he was eliminated and I won the west coast broadcast.
